paths.name: @/lib/supabase-server
paths.message: developer-API routes must authenticate by API key via validateApiKey() from '@/lib/api-auth', never by cookie/session. middleware.ts skips Supabase session creation for the public developer-API paths AND serves open CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), so a cookie-authed developer-API route would be a CSRF hole. See .claude/skills/kingflexy-developer-api/SKILL.md.
